pages.title: Mad Hatter Watching Alice Put Jam on the Dormouse's Nose Beside the Teapot Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter watching Alice dab jam onto the Dormouse's nose, with a patterned teapot and bread on the table. Alice leans toward the tiny seated mouse while the Hatter rests his chin in his hands. Rounded cups, a labeled jam jar, and broad garden shapes fill the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter and the March Hare Celebrating the Queen of Hearts' Unbirthday During Alice's Trial Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter and March Hare celebrate the Queen of Hearts' unbirthday during Alice's trial in this printable coloring page, presenting a heart-decorated cake. Confetti hangs above the candles as the Queen and King watch from their raised bench. Card guards, Alice, and the White Rabbit add smaller figures around the central pair on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Singing the Unbirthday Song While the March Hare Plays a Teapot Organ Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the Mad Hatter singing the unbirthday song with one hand raised while the March Hare plays a teapot-shaped organ nearby. Steam curls from the instrument's tall pipes, and musical notes surround the performers. The Hatter's patched coat, keyboard, and cake-covered tea table supply distinct sections throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Disney Mad Hatter Wearing His Oversized 10/6 Top Hat and Enormous Bow Tie Coloring Page
pages.description: Disney's Mad Hatter tips his oversized top hat and extends one hand in this printable coloring page, wearing a huge bow tie and buttoned vest. His open grin, pointed coat tails, and large shoes stand out against the blank background. Broad clothing sections keep this character coloring sheet focused on his full-length pose.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Hosting Alice, the March Hare, and the Dormouse at a Tea Table Beneath a Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter hosting Alice, the March Hare, and the Dormouse at a long tea table beneath a leafy tree. The Dormouse peeks from a central teapot while cups, cakes, and more pots cover the cloth. Large tree shapes frame the guests, with smaller tableware details distributed across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Listening to His Pocket Watch Beside the March Hare's Butter Dish Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter listens to a large pocket watch in this printable coloring page, seated beside a covered butter dish, a knife, and a teacup. A long chain curves across his diamond-patterned vest, and his round mouth gives him a surprised expression. This coloring sheet pairs broad hat and jacket areas with small chain links and watch markings.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Asking Alice His Raven and Writing Desk Riddle at the Tea Party Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter asking Alice his raven-and-writing-desk riddle at the tea party, gesturing while she rests her chin on one hand. A raven perches on a cup in front of them, with a small writing desk behind. Hanging lanterns, sandwiches, and clustered teapots add fine details to the garden coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Singing Twinkle Twinkle Little Bat While Alice Listens Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter sings Twinkle Twinkle Little Bat while Alice listens in this printable coloring page, with musical notes and a small bat above them. He raises one hand and holds the other against his chest as Alice leans on the tea table. Lanterns, cups, and rounded pots provide separate enclosed shapes across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Listening to the Dormouse Tell the Story of the Three Sisters in a Treacle Well Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter listening as the Dormouse tells his story of three sisters in a treacle well beside the tea table. The mouse stands on a teapot, spreading its paws beneath a thought bubble showing the sisters around a brick well. Broad hat and teapot areas contrast with the tiny faces on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Waking the Sleeping Dormouse with a Little Tea on Its Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter wakes the sleeping Dormouse with a drop of tea on its nose in this printable coloring page, tilting a small decorated cup. The mouse nestles inside a larger teacup with its paws resting on the rim. Looped bunting, garden shrubs, and scattered tableware surround the close view on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter and the March Hare Settling the Dormouse Into a Large Teapot Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter and March Hare settling the sleepy Dormouse into a large patterned teapot beneath a hanging garden lantern. The Hatter supports the mouse while the Hare holds the lid above the opening. Wide teapot panels and coat sections balance smaller cup patterns, whiskers, and hand details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Announcing a Clean Cup as the Tea Party Guests Change Seats Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter announces a clean cup as the tea-party guests change seats in this printable coloring page, raising a cup and pointing across the table. Alice turns beside the March Hare, who carries a teapot, while the Dormouse remains tucked inside another pot. Empty chairs, saucers, and spoons define the busy outdoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Giving Evidence Before the King and Queen of Hearts with Tea and Bread in His Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter giving evidence before the King and Queen of Hearts, holding a teacup and a slice of bread. The royals sit above him on heart-backed thrones, with the King's scepter beside the courtroom rail. His broad coat and tall hat anchor this coloring sheet against straight architectural outlines.

pages.title: Mad Hatter as Hatta Carrying Bread Trays to the Lion and Unicorn in Through the Looking-glass Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter appears as Hatta carrying trays of bread to the Lion and Unicorn in this printable coloring page inspired by Through the Looking-Glass. Round rolls and scored loaves fill both trays as the seated animals look up at him. The Lion's layered mane and Unicorn's curling hair add detailed sections to the open outdoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Running Out of the Courtroom with His Shoes Left Behind Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter running out of the courtroom in his socks, leaving a pair of buckled shoes behind the open door. His coat tails flare as he lifts one knee and hurries past the paneled bench. A gavel, stone blocks, and floorboards create smaller background areas around the moving figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Fitting a Top Hat on Alice in His Hatmaking Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter fits a feathered top hat onto Alice in this printable coloring page, surrounded by hats and sewing supplies in his workshop. His spool bandolier, patterned vest, and striped trousers contrast with her broad skirt. Feathers, a pincushion, and carefully outlined curls provide smaller details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Disney Mad Hatter Pouring Tea Into Three Cups From a Triple-spout Teapot Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Disney's Mad Hatter pouring three streams of tea from a triple-spout teapot into patterned cups at the garden tea table. He supports the unusual pot with both hands beneath his tall 10/6 hat. Splashes, curved cup designs, and hanging lanterns offer small details beside the larger clothing shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Disney Mad Hatter Presenting Alice with an Unbirthday Cake and a Tall Candle Coloring Page
pages.description: Disney's Mad Hatter presents Alice with an unbirthday cake in this printable coloring page, holding three decorated tiers beneath a tall, wavy candle and flame. Alice raises her hands beside the platter, with a cup and teapot near her skirt. Star and dot patterns on the cake add small enclosed shapes to this character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Disney Mad Hatter Watching Alice's Unbirthday Candle Launch Into the Air Like a Firework Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Disney's Mad Hatter and Alice watching her unbirthday candle launch like a firework, surrounded by stars above a small cake. The Hatter touches his hat brim while Alice sits at a round table with a scalloped cloth. Wide clothing areas frame the curved motion lines and striped candle on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Disney Mad Hatter Pouring Tea Into His Jacket Sleeve with a Teacup Beneath His Elbow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Disney's Mad Hatter lifting a small teapot high above a matching cup, with a long stream of tea between them. His tall 10/6 hat, oversized bow tie, and wide coat lapels dominate the close view. Curved pottery patterns and a few background table settings add smaller sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Disney Mad Hatter Examining the White Rabbit's Open Watch Through a Salt Shaker Coloring Page
pages.description: Disney's Mad Hatter examines the White Rabbit's open pocket watch through a salt shaker in this printable coloring page, holding the shaker against one eye. Exposed gears and watch hands sit inside the hinged case, with the chain hanging below his fingers. Broad hat and jacket shapes surround these small mechanical details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Disney Mad Hatter and the March Hare Ducking as Springs and Gears Fly From the White Rabbit's Watch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Disney's Mad Hatter and March Hare ducking as springs, screws, and gears fly from the White Rabbit's open pocket watch. Both characters hold their hands near their heads beside the scattered mechanism. Curving motion marks surround the airborne parts, while broad clothing shapes keep the figures distinct on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Disney Mad Hatter Returning the Remains of the Broken Pocket Watch to the White Rabbit Coloring Page
pages.description: Disney's Mad Hatter returns the remains of a broken pocket watch to the White Rabbit in this printable coloring page, offering the damaged case and gears. The Rabbit looks down through round spectacles with his paws spread apart. A winding path and spotted mushrooms frame the pair, leaving broad clothing areas and smaller watch parts on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Disney Mad Hatter Serving Tea While the March Hare Holds Half a Teacup Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Disney's Mad Hatter serving tea while the March Hare holds a broken teacup, its jagged sides separated beneath the falling stream. A second cracked cup rests on the table beside plates and another teapot. Curved pottery patterns and the Hare's long ears add distinctive outlines to this garden coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter's 10/6 Top Hat Resting Beside a Teapot, Teacup, and Oversized Bow Tie Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter's tall top hat rests beside a teapot, teacup, and oversized bow tie in this printable coloring page, with feathers rising from its band. A hanging tag and gathered hatband break up the large crown, while dots decorate the bow. This still-life coloring sheet combines broad accessory shapes with fine feather lines and scalloped pottery rims.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Wearing His Feathered Top Hat, Patterned Bow Tie, and Thread-spool Bandolier Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page portrays Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter wearing a feathered top hat, patterned bow tie, and diagonal thread-spool bandolier above a wide-lapelled coat. Tousled curls frame his face, and hatpins rise beside the feathers. The portrait coloring sheet brings the small spool ends, bow patterns, and layered hatband close enough for detailed coloring.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Walking Across the Long Tea Table to Greet Alice Coloring Page
pages.description: Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter walks across a long tea table to greet seated Alice in this printable coloring page, stepping between cakes, cups, and teapots. His patched coat flares behind his outstretched arm, and the Dormouse peeks from a pot below. Hanging lanterns and tall chairs frame the many small tableware shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Leaning Close to Tiny Alice Beside an Enormous Teacup Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter leaning close to tiny Alice beside an enormous decorated teacup, with Alice standing on its saucer. His curly hair and tall 10/6 hat fill the opposite side of the scene. The dramatic size difference leaves broad cup sections around the small dress and facial details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Making a Tiny Dress for Alice at the Tea Table Coloring Page
pages.description: Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter makes a tiny dress for Alice at the tea table in this printable coloring page, holding it between his hands as she watches. Scissors, loose fabric pieces, and thread spools sit among the cups and teapots. The miniature apron and scalloped hem provide small details within the larger garden scene on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Carrying Tiny Alice Inside His Top Hat Through the Woods Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter carrying tiny Alice inside his top hat through the woods, holding its brim with both hands. Alice peeks above the opening as he steps along a path between spotted mushrooms. Repeating coat patterns and curling hair add detail, while tree trunks form broader background areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Young Mad Hatter Watching His Father Zanik at Princess Iracebeth's Failed Coronation Coloring Page
pages.description: The young Mad Hatter watches his father Zanik at Princess Iracebeth's failed coronation in this printable coloring page, standing below her raised throne and oversized crown. Iracebeth grips the crown with both hands, and heart shapes decorate her dress. Matching feathered hats, patterned vests, and striped trousers provide fine clothing details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Allowing the Red Knights to Capture Him While Alice Escapes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter allowing the Red Knights to capture him while Alice escapes through an open, rose-covered garden gate. Heart-emblazoned guards flank the Hatter, with one holding his upper arm. His decorated cuffs and spool bandolier add fine detail beside the knights' broad armor panels on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Sewing an Elaborate Hat in the Red Queen's Castle Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter sews an elaborate hat in the Red Queen's castle workshop in this printable coloring page, drawing thread upward above the patched crown. Scissors, buttons, fabric scraps, and spools cover his worktable, with a pincushion fastened at his cuff. Stone walls and a heart emblem frame the detailed sewing scene on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Presenting an Enormous Decorated Hat to the Red Queen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter presenting an enormous decorated hat to the Red Queen, its feathers rising between the two figures. Strings of beads, a large bow, and an oval ornament cover the hat as the Queen clasps her hands. Heart motifs on her gown echo the throne behind this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Talking with Alice Across the Hatmaking Worktable in the Red Queen's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter talks with Alice across a hatmaking worktable in the Red Queen's castle in this printable coloring page, beside a feathered hat on a stand. Scissors and a pincushion rest between them beneath a tall heart-patterned window. The coloring sheet mixes broad dress panels with striped trousers, curled hair, and detailed cuffs.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Reunited with the Cheshire Cat and His Recovered Top Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page reunites Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter with the Cheshire Cat and his recovered top hat, which he holds in both hands. The striped cat floats beside his shoulder, curling its large tail above an enormous grin. A feathered hat, spool bandolier, and striped trousers provide distinct patterned sections on the character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Talking with Alice on the White Queen's Castle Parapet Coloring Page
pages.description: Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter talks with Alice on the White Queen's castle parapet in this printable coloring page, gesturing beside a wall of spiral-decorated battlements. Alice rests her hands on the stonework while pointed towers and flags rise behind them. The coloring sheet combines large dress and wall sections with patches, curls, and the Hatter's patterned bow.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Standing Beside the White Queen and Her Chess-piece Army Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter beside the White Queen and her chess-piece army, with rook-shaped guards and smaller pawn soldiers behind them. The Queen clasps her hands above a sweeping gown, contrasting with the Hatter's feathered hat and spool bandolier. Spears and diamond armor emblems add smaller shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Crossing Swords with Stayne on the Chessboard Battlefield Coloring Page
pages.description: Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter crosses swords with Stayne on the chessboard battlefield in this printable coloring page, their long blades meeting above their raised hands. Stayne wears an eye patch and heart-decorated armor, while the Hatter braces in striped trousers and a long coat. Large floor squares ground the two full-length figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Dancing the Futterwacken After the Frabjous Day Victory Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter dancing the Futterwacken after the Frabjous Day victory, raising one knee and curling his arms outward. Floating chess pieces and streamers surround his feathered hat and flaring coat tails. Striped trousers, a dotted bow tie, and buttoned boots offer varied enclosed sections on the dancing character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Johnny Depp Mad Hatter Saying Goodbye to Alice After the Frabjous Day Celebration Coloring Page
pages.description: Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter says goodbye to Alice after the Frabjous Day celebration in this printable coloring page, holding one hand against his chest as she waves. His patched coat and tall 10/6 hat stand beside Alice's broad apron and skirt. Bunting hangs above the pair, with small mushrooms behind this close character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Young Mad Hatter Presenting His First Handmade Paper Hat to His Father Zanik in the Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the young Mad Hatter presenting his first handmade paper hat to his father Zanik in a workshop lined with hatmaking supplies. He holds the folded hat in both hands beneath his father's feathered top hat and curled mustache. Hat forms, rolled materials, and striped socks add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Young Mad Hatter Leading Alice Through Witzend Toward His Father's Hat Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: The young Mad Hatter leads Alice through Witzend toward his father's hat shop in this printable coloring page, pointing at decorated hats in the display window. Three hats stand behind the glass beside a carved storefront and hanging street lantern. Cobblestones and window trim create smaller background shapes around the walking pair on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Showing Alice a Tiny Paper Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter sharing his tiny paper hat with Alice beside the Hightopp family portrait from Alice Through the Looking Glass. He points toward the folded hat in his palm while Alice clasps her hands. The ornate picture frame, thread spools, and pleated skirt provide fine detail within the room on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Sitting with Time, the March Hare, and Mallymkun at the Tea Table in Alice Through the Looking Glass Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter sits with Time, the March Hare, and Mallymkun at the tea table in this printable coloring page from Alice Through the Looking Glass. Time holds a pocket watch over his gear-patterned clothing, and Mallymkun peeks from a teapot below. Tiered cake stands, hanging lanterns, and clustered cups add many small sections to this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Holding the Chronosphere Beside Alice in Alice Through the Looking Glass Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter holding the Chronosphere beside Alice in Alice Through the Looking Glass, with gears and clock faces surrounding them. Interlocking rings enclose the device's small center, while Alice's decorated collar and shoulder panels add curling patterns. The close portrait coloring sheet balances intricate mechanical shapes with the Hatter's broad hat and coat.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Discovering His Tiny Family Inside the Red Queen's Ant Farm in Alice Through the Looking Glass Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter discovering his tiny family inside the Red Queen's ant farm from Alice Through the Looking Glass. He bends toward three top-hatted relatives standing above winding tunnels in the clear-sided enclosure. Castle towers rise behind his feathered hat, while small tunnel stones and clothing patterns add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Sprinkling Growing Cake Onto His Tiny Family to Restore Their Size Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter sprinkles growing cake over his tiny family to restore their size in this printable coloring page, kneeling beside three miniature relatives. He holds a layered slice in one hand while crumbs fall from the other, above their top hats. Thread spools, striped trousers, and broad tiled flooring structure this family scene on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter Embracing His Father Zanik After the Hightopp Family Reunion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter embracing his father Zanik after the Hightopp family reunion, with both men smiling beneath their tall hats. The Hatter's feathered hat and spool bandolier distinguish him from his father's curled mustache. A teapot, stacked books, and tied curtain add smaller room details around the central embrace on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mad Hatter with Three Top-Hatted Companions Coloring Page
pages.description: Johnny Depp's Mad Hatter stands with his top-hatted Hightopp clan at the White Queen's celebration in this printable coloring page, tipping his hat beside his family. Decorated coats, striped stockings, and feathered hats fill the foreground beneath a heart-trimmed canopy. Flower arrangements and a small tiered stand add fine background shapes to this detailed family coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Mad Hatter in Key Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter in Wonderland's key room, tipping his feathered 10/6 hat beside rows of hanging keys and a tall door. Additional keys lie on the floor around his shoes, while checks and buttons decorate his vest. The coloring sheet offers broad coat sections alongside small key teeth and bow-tie dots.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Mad Hatter in Tiny Door Hallway Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter kneels in a tiny-door hallway in this printable coloring page, stretching both arms between the walls beneath an arched ceiling and hanging lantern. Spiral patterns cover his coat beside the miniature doorway and its keyhole. A framed portrait, striped trousers, and scattered brick outlines add smaller details around the crouching figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Mad Hatter in Royal Courtroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places the Mad Hatter in a royal courtroom, standing with a cane before a tall chair, curtained windows, and hanging heraldic banners. His feathered top hat carries two 10/6 tags above a dotted bow and patterned vest. Broad coat panels contrast with small buttons and window divisions across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Mad Hatter in Wonderland Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mad Hatter holds a heart-marked teacup in Wonderland's garden in this printable coloring page, standing behind a small table with a teapot and saucer. Flowers and spotted mushrooms border a winding path, with the Cheshire Cat resting on a branch above. Large hat and coat sections balance the smaller garden details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Alice in Wonderland Mad Hatter in White Rabbit's House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Mad Hatter inside the White Rabbit's house, holding a teacup beneath his tall 10/6 hat with a bow at its brim. Diamond patterns repeat across his coat and the wallpaper behind him. Clocks, curtained windows, ceiling beams, and a small tea table give this interior coloring sheet many separate enclosed areas.
